title: UAAP: UST women survive Ateneo scare, stay unbeaten at 12-0

blocks.text: Defending champion University of Santo Tomas hurdled its biggest test yet, defeating Ateneo de Manila University, 87-80, to extend its perfect run to 12 games in the UAAP Season 89 Collegiate Women’s Basketball Tournament on Sunday at the Araneta Coliseum.
